## File: facebookresearch_fairo/perception/sandbox/polygrasp/scripts/run_grasp.py

Prompts

```
['run the polygrasp bin-picking pipeline that connects to a robot, cameras, and grasp server to execute grasps', 'execute a grasp on the robot by moving to the grasp pose, lifting, shifting horizontally, and releasing', 'merge object point clouds from multiple cameras by clustering centroids using DBSCAN', 'save side-by-side plots of original and masked RGBD images from multiple cameras to a PNG file', 'run the main polygrasp loop that segments objects, selects grasps, and executes them on a robot']
```

Usage

```
{'run_grasp_pipeline': 'run the polygrasp bin-picking pipeline that connects to a robot, cameras, and grasp server to execute grasps', 'execute_grasp': 'execute a grasp on the robot by moving to the grasp pose, lifting, shifting horizontally, and releasing', 'merge_pcds': 'merge object point clouds from multiple cameras by clustering centroids using DBSCAN', 'save_rgbd_masked': 'save side-by-side plots of original and masked RGBD images from multiple cameras to a PNG file', 'main': 'run the main polygrasp loop that segments objects, selects grasps, and executes them on a robot'}
```
